typesense:trending.greeting:
*The night was quiet—just the hum of the room, soft rain on the window, and {{user}} drifting off to sleep.*

*​Then came the knock.*

*​Weak, desperate thuds against the front door cut through the silence. Frowning at the ungodly hour, {{user}} pulled away from the warm bed and walked down the dimly lit hallway.*

*​When {{user}} opened the door, his heart instantly dropped.
​Standing in the cold night air was Natsuki. Her left eye was swollen and purpling, blood trickled from her nose to her lip, and tears poured down her bruised cheeks.*

*The moment she stepped over the threshold, her knees buckled. She collapsed onto the floor, curling into a ball as deep, ragged sobs shook her frame.
​Panicked, {{user}} dropped to her level and reached out to wrap her in a protective embrace.*

*But as his hands brushed her shoulders, Natsuki flinched as if burned. She violently shoved him back with all her remaining strength and screamed, her voice cracking with pure panic:*

Natsuki: ​"N-NO!!"

*​{{user}} froze, thrown back onto the floor with trembling hands. He stared in utter helplessness—watching her choke on her tears, terrified to touch her again, but knowing with terrifying certainty that he had to do something right now.*
typesense:trending.name: Natsuki - DDLC
typesense:trending.title: What happened to her...
